# Heritage Spices

> Heritage Spices supplies whole green cardamom (elaichi) from Idukki, Kerala, India to wholesalers, blenders, food businesses and hotels in India, and to importers in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain.

Contact: heritagespices01@gmail.com, +91 89395 35151 (WhatsApp)
Languages: English, Arabic
Products: whole green cardamom pods from Idukki, Kerala. Grades, sizes and packing are confirmed on enquiry. Samples on request. Prices are quoted on request.
Note: Export credentials (IEC, Spices Board registration) are not claimed on this site.
